gloss: in the blink of an eye, in no time

definitions.gloss: in the blink of an eye, in no time, before you know it
definitions.explanation: An expression describing something happening extremely quickly, so fast that one can only say "ah!" Literally: the interval of saying "ah."

examples.japanese: あっという{間|ま}に{終|お}わった。
examples.english: It was over in the blink of an eye.

examples.japanese: {休|やす}みはあっという{間|ま}に{過|す}ぎた。
examples.english: The vacation was over before I knew it.

examples.japanese: {久|ひさ}しぶりに{友達|ともだち}と{話|はな}していたら、{時間|じかん}があっという{間|ま}に{過|す}ぎた。
examples.english: I was chatting with a friend I hadn't seen in a while, and time flew by in no time.

notes:
あっという{間|ま} literally means "the space of saying 'ah!'" — so brief that all you can say is "ah!"

COMMON PATTERNS:
- あっという{間|ま}に: in no time (followed by a verb)
- あっという{間|ま}だった: it was over in a flash
- あっという{間|ま}の〜: fleeting ~ (modifying a noun)

USAGE:
Nearly always used with the particle に as あっという{間|ま}に. This expression is common in both spoken and written Japanese.
